# job sbom

## Install tools with mise: ok

## Install cargo-cyclonedx: ok
cargo install cargo-cyclonedx --version 0.5.9 --locked

## Fetch the frontend's npm packages: ok
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter @cmdr/desktop

## Generate the SBOMs: ok
cargo cyclonedx --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --format json --spec-version 1.5 --target aarch64-apple-darwin --override-filename sbom-aarch64 -q
cargo cyclonedx --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --format json --spec-version 1.5 --target x86_64-apple-darwin --override-filename sbom-x64 -q
pnpm --filter @cmdr/desktop exec svelte-kit sync
pnpm --filter @cmdr/desktop build

## Hand the SBOMs to the attest job: artifact sboms
  Cmdr_0.61.0_aarch64.rust.cdx.json 8be54424cbee8127b257489d787165d185145488b359f7331b425696d73c7275
  Cmdr_0.61.0_frontend.cdx.json fda58069fccb0bb31e660fd689863ef7c9ee80fe703ae3ee1b9c46381b0bed72
  Cmdr_0.61.0_x64.rust.cdx.json 670644df217e04d769f33defb3eaeac9a2fd6886b8b8b9d70464aa58adbb82b7
